component.description: The design component this Task implements. Must be one of the known components (a directory under specs/design/components/).

title.description: Short human-facing title; must be unique across planned and existing Tasks.

dependsOn.description: Component names this Task depends on (never issue numbers). Empty when it has no dependencies.

origin.description: Where the Task came from; omit for the default 'spec-plan'.

rationale.description: One sentence: why this Task exists.
